observations.contract: Direct versus mesh-derived owned paving support
observations.trace: PreparedCityProduct.generate calls PreparedCityGround::from_scene. For owned terrain the worker computes a centred outer extent from selected ring sizes and add_owned_region feeds clipped source triangles to GroundSupport with zero origin. Focused GroundMeshes separately builds vista chunks and accumulates support from each mesh plus its LOD origin; focused installation uses product.ground for paving and GroundMeshes.support for markers/paths. The tactical vista path similarly derives its urban GroundSupport from presented meshes and chunk origins before building paving.
observations.remaining: For conditional nonzero origins this is connected evidence for REVIEW-VISTA-OWNED-SURFACE-ORIGIN-FRAME-001, not an automatically separate accepted defect. Actual document origin policy, content, reflection/native transforms, paving and support overlap remain open.

observations.trace: The inspected owned exterior filter tests natural and cut-face centroids against the collar while preserving foundation solid triangles. The inspected owned collision path filters the same natural/cut centroids and keeps foundation colliders on a separate path. Source-only fixture1651 asserts preservation of foundation bearings in a selected example.
observations.remaining: This is bounded source counterevidence against assuming every collar cuts foundation bearings. Exact complete collision construction, actual clipping, all fixtures and current rendered/physical outcomes remain unexecuted and open.

conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional source-derived support-filter and precision-policy question; no observed product result or checkpoint3821 finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Accepted natural settlement triangles and GroundSupport walkable-face admission shared by focused paving, city markers and tactical paving.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The source owner can retain a finite nondegenerate natural face and the owned mesh clipper retains an interior face, while GroundSupport unconditionally drops upward faces whose unnormalized cross-product Y is at most 0.00001.
conditional_findings.trace: BoundedSettlementTerrain::from_foundations accepts Position<Scene> natural points, validates finite geometry and compiles a support-query index. Its GroundTriangle preparation rejects determinants only at a double-precision roundoff-scaled bound. GroundPresentation reverses natural winding, PreparedTriangle retains wholly interior triangles and the owned mesh stores the resulting positions. GroundSupport.add_triangles translates points and discards when the unnormalized cross-product Y is <= CLIP_EPSILON=0.00001; both direct add_owned_region and mesh-derived add_mesh use that filter. CityGround mesh generation clips streets/yards against GroundSupport; focused regional city position and path geometry also consume support.position/clip.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: Let the sole natural source face be (20,7,20), (20+1/512,7,20), (20,7,20+1/512), in scene metres, with no foundations, a positive contact tolerance and a selected owned region covering x,z=20..20+1/512. The finite points and sums satisfy the inspected settlement finite/topology predicates; the source determinant is 1/262144 square metres, vastly above the double-roundoff bound. Reversed presentation winding has upward cross Y=1/262144, approximately 0.000003815, so the face is below the GroundSupport threshold despite its positive horizontal area. A strict interior support point can pass the inspected source half-planes and finite nonzero normal admission. If no other support covers that point, the filtered GroundSupport has no such face to query or clip; even the later clip emission also applies an area-related epsilon. These are symbolic comparisons of source expressions, not construction, indexing, queries, clipping or rendered output.
conditional_findings.safeguards: No complete scene, producer-created tiny face, construction, index, support query, collision, paving or renderer was run. The width here is about1.95mm and its practical impact and intended geometric tolerance remain open. Region membership, no collar removal, successful preparation and absence of overlapping supporting faces are explicit conditions. Arbitrary malformed geometry or a real missing visible surface is not asserted. Source tests are unexecuted.
dependencies: Trace supported geographic/property generation and clipping to see whether such small source or clipped faces occur, and whether another face covers each affected point.
Establish the desired numerical accuracy and units for walkability, clipping and paving coverage, then compare exact historical and current owners before aliasing.
Trace native math and renderer behavior only after the authorized stop point if product validation is later requested.
acceptance_requirements: For supported terrain faces, physical support, displayed ground, marker/path support and paving coverage share an explicit, justified degeneracy/precision policy or a documented bounded approximation.
